hero.eyebrow: For Tamil Nadu's brands and creators
hero.title: Every brand and creator deal, on the record.
hero.lede: Agree the terms, deliver the work and settle the payment in one record neither side can rewrite. Brands pay creators directly; Colyv never holds the money.
hero.imageAlt: A Chola-style granite temple tower, carved tier upon tier, standing on a dark stage. A thousand years old, and still standing.

steps.title: Five steps, each one written down.
steps.lede: A deal moves forward only when the side whose turn it is acts. Both of you always see where it stands and who it is waiting on.

1.title: The brand sends the terms
1.body: Fee, deliverables, dates and usage rights, in a memo the creator can accept, decline or ask to change.

2.title: Both sides agree
2.body: Once the creator accepts, the terms are fixed. Nobody can quietly edit what was agreed.

3.title: The work is made
3.body: Where the terms ask for it, the creator shows a draft first. Then they post, and send the live link.

4.title: The work is approved
4.body: The brand approves it or asks for changes. If the brand stays silent past the agreed window, it is approved for them, so work is never held hostage.

5.title: The creator is paid
5.body: The brand pays the creator directly and marks it paid. Only the creator can confirm the money arrived.

record.title: Sealed, step by step.
record.lede: Every step of a deal is sealed to the one before it, so a changed or missing entry shows. Each day, two independent timestamp authorities sign over that day's records.

points.1: Both sides read the same record, and either can check it themselves.
points.2: Terms, links and notes appear as fingerprints, never as text anyone can alter.
points.3: A dispute sits on the record too, with each side's account, never our verdict.

record.imageAlt: A cast-bronze seal with a woven guilloché pattern and Tamil lettering around its rim.

money.title: We never touch your money.
money.body: Brands pay creators straight from their own bank, by UPI or transfer. Colyv records that the payment was made and when it arrived. It never receives, holds or moves a rupee.

points.1: Find creators by city, niche and price, and see how each one has delivered before.
points.2: Send terms, approve work and mark payments from one board, with your team in their own roles.
points.3: Build a payment record creators can see before they work with you.

points.1: See who is hiring, what they pay and how quickly they have paid before.
points.2: Every deal's terms, dates and payment in one place, with what is due next first on your screen.
points.3: A delivery record that is yours, built from what happened, not from reviews.

closing.title: Your next deal, on the record.
closing.body: Sign in with your phone number. Brands and creators each see their own side.

footer.line: Made in Tamil Nadu. Colyv records deals; brands pay creators directly.
